paper_title: Defending Against Social Engineering Attacks in the Age of LLMs
caption: Distribution of samples (%) across varying values of sample-level ambiguity standard deviation and sample-level maximum ambiguity.
model_annotation: The chart represents the distribution of samples across varying values of sample-level ambiguity standard deviation and sample-level maximum ambiguity. It features two concentric pie sections: the outer ring indicates the ambiguity standard deviation percentages, which includes four slices labeled as follows: "Std: 0.0" (49.0% in dark blue), "Std: 0.47" (7.0% in a lighter blue), "Std: 0.82" (5.0% in a light blue), and "Std: 0.94" (14.2% in a medium blue). The inner ring represents maximum ambiguity, with three labeled slices: "Max: 1" (38.0% in a medium blue), "Max: 2" (39.0% in a lighter blue), and "Max: 3" (the remaining percentage). The chart includes a legend that specifies the colors corresponding to the labels, but it does not visually emphasize any slices. The segments appear to be ordered in a way that groups related values together, while their sizes vary significantly.
